verdict.rationale: Pika documents a clip-extension app that makes a clip longer by generating extra frames, continuing from the clip's final frame so the scene and action keep moving. That directly covers extending a clip without regenerating the original footage. Region-level edits (paint an area and choose when the new element appears; swap or insert elements in a clip) come close to editing part of a clip, but they are not documented as regenerating a chosen time segment. missing for 10: explicit regeneration of a selected time segment of an existing video, detail on extension length and quality limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
